summary: Practise humanitarian monitoring tools, data checks and evaluation planning. Explore the five-day course and apply the methods to your programme work.
lede: Humanitarian programme monitoring and evaluation uses field evidence to review results and guide programme adjustments. For foundation-level programme staff and partner personnel, this training develops practical skills in defining indicators, building monitoring tools, checking and triangulating data, gathering community feedback, and framing evaluation questions.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for staff and partner personnel who collect humanitarian programme evidence, review activity progress, handle community feedback or use monitoring findings to adjust delivery.
modules: Results Frameworks and Theories of Change
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with humanitarian programme activities or routine programme reporting is useful. No prior evaluation-design experience is required for the foundation-level exercises.
